Are you looking for ultimate freedom on the road and weekly payments in your bank account? As a Delivery Driver AH Online in Amsterdam, you will enjoy independence and a great starting salary. Step into your office on wheels and make countless customers happy! 🚚💨💸

What we offer
- A great salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks
- Standard 8.33% holiday allowance to do fun things
- Plenty of holiday days for your well-deserved rest
- Access to helpful training courses to keep growing
- Freedom on the road with a truck full of goodies
- Guaranteed pension accrual from your first workday

Who you are
To get started as a Delivery Driver AH Online, it is important that you like to stay active. You know exactly how to navigate safely through the traffic in Amsterdam. Furthermore, you bring the following for this top job: 🚗💼🏃

- You are in possession of a valid driving license B.
- You speak fluent English or Dutch for smooth customer contact.
- You are available for at least two days a week to rock this job.

What will you do
Your day starts at the distribution center in Amsterdam, where you load up the iconic blue box truck. Once on the road, you are the boss of your own route with a great playlist in the background. #baanrader 🚗 Work pleasure is guaranteed, because carrying crates to the kitchen means you can skip the gym today! 🎶📦💪

Where will you work
At Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam, there is an amazing atmosphere at the HUB. You start with a nice chat with friendly colleagues before you hit the road independently. The work pleasure really shines through when you greet every customer with a smile and make their day better! 🏢🤝😊

Job application
Ready to start as a Delivery Driver AH Online? Hit that button and apply today. You will always get a response from us within 24 hours, so what are you waiting for! 🚀👇🎉  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

Where will you work
Kuehne + Nagel is a global leader in transportation and logistics, and it's also a remarkably pleasant place to work! Your future colleagues have praise for the company – and that matters, doesn't it? In Veghel, you'll serve various prestigious clients, including Mars

A job in the early morning, so you have plenty of time left for your hobbies in the rest of the afternoon! Or for groceries, perhaps 😉. Who you are
As a warehouse employee, you're active in the early morning! You never get out of bed on the wrong side. We don't ask for much, but we do require the following:

Then the packages are sorted via a conveyor belt, and the deliverers can load their own vans. On to the customers!

As an experienced orbital welder, you play a key role in developing and producing prototypes and initial production runs. You work closely with engineers to evaluate new designs, determine the correct welding method, and apply it directly in the cleanroom production area. Your craftsmanship sets the standard for the rest of the production process. Thanks to your technical insight, designs are elevated to a higher level even before they reach the production line.

This role isn’t just about welding. It’s an opportunity to work daily with the latest technologies such as welding robots, cobots, lasers, and 3D printers. You bring knowledge and experience as an orbital welder perhaps also as a TIG welder or fabrication technician and you know better than anyone how to read technical drawings and translate them into top-quality work. Your structured working style, digital skills, and eagerness to learn make a real difference in a production environment where innovation is the standard.

You’ll join a team full of expertise, but also one that gives you the space to grow. There’s plenty of attention given to your development, initiative is appreciated, and your contribution to the final product is visible, tangible, and measurable. You’re not just creating metal connections here, you’re building solutions that make a global impact.

- You have demonstrable work experience at a comparable level
- You have experience with orbital welding
- You speak fluent English or Dutch
